english.legislation: Contrary to section 33(1)(a), (6) and (8) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 and section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Extractive waste is, broadly, waste produced by the extractive industry and resulting from prospecting, extraction, treatment and storage of mineral resources and the working of quarries. This will typically include tailings (i.e. the waste solids or slurries that remain after the treatment of minerals by processing), rock which is weathered, below specification or otherwise unsaleable, overburden (i.e. the material moved to access the mineral), and soil.
